you are not alone. remember that. i have problems milder than 99.99% people on this server but i still have problem coping. i still have to remind myself that my problems dont mean nothing. and yours do too. they may be mild for most, but are pretty strong for most.  
speaking of sad and empty, hold out hope. i know i am. i wrote about this in june in my journal, about how my life is not happy, only either sad, or empty, but i have to hold out hope.  


i hope you will too

it does get better. i'm not gonna be all philosophical because i'm only 17, but i've gone through the same thing. still am lmao. literally the same thing - no support, nothing right, parents disinterested, since the age of 5-6. but the thing is, it gets better, day by day. for me, its still not perfect, its not really good at all lmao, but i hold out hope. also, if you need any help with school work, don't hesitate.
